universe_note:
SECOND RUN, 2026-09-04, same day as the first. Atlas landed 4 fresh-context placement audits (commit f187057, run universe-audit minor-nsr-permits --placement) on CATERPILLAR, CUMMINS, FUEL-TECH and CECO-ENVIRONMENTAL, all on the money-corner link emissions-aftertreatment-and-catalyst, all status PASS. This run was asked to seat those four rows under audit_scope PLACEMENT on the strength of that PASS. Checked and refused: CLAUDE.md's `run universe-audit --placement` clause states in its own text that a current PASS entry 'admits that issuer to run deepdive without the whole census being COMPLETE' -- it names deepdive, never screen. The screen row's own admission rule (CLAUDE.md's `run screen` row, and tools/check_screen.py's `_placement_admissible`) tests only the placement's own `evidence[]` tags, never `placement_audits[]`; commit f187057's diff (checked directly) added the four `placement_audits[]` entries and touched nothing else on any of the four placements -- `evidence[0].tag` is still INFERRED on all four, unchanged. Confirmed empirically before writing this file: a draft CAT row with audit_scope PLACEMENT and placement_audit_ref pointed at the PASS entry still fails tools/check_screen.py with 'audit_scope PLACEMENT on an un-audited mapping requires every evidence item on the placement to be VERIFIED; INFERRED issuer-role evidence needs the census audit' -- reverted before commit. So the four placement audits are real, correctly independent, and genuinely useful (they will unblock `run deepdive` on these four issuers once selection promotes any of them to O1), but they do not and structurally cannot seat a screen row by themselves under the currently committed gate: doing so would require either promoting the placement's own evidence tag to VERIFIED (data/mappings/, which I do not own and did not touch) or a full census audit bringing the mapping to status COMPLETE with audit.status PASS (also not this run's lane). This is named here rather than silently worked around; it belongs to Atlas/Ron to decide whether check_screen.py's admission rule should also recognize a current PASS placement_audits[] entry, or whether the --placement mechanism is deliberately scoped to deepdive only. Net result: identical to the first run, zero rows seated, for the same reason (evidence tier), now with the placement-audit path checked and ruled out rather than merely flagged as a next step.

First-run note, unchanged below: Chain-level campaign-v1 screen (identity_schema campaign-v1, scenario_id null), first run for this chain. Universe built per LINK across all 14 links, worked in priority order: the one money-corner link first, then the one CHOKE_POINT link, then the rest by chain position. The mapping (data/mappings/minor-nsr-permits.json, 15 issuers, 18 placements) is ACTIVE and carries no audit block at all (no fresh-context census audit has ever run on it), so every row this run rests entirely on Ron's 2026-09-01 PLACEMENT-scope rule: audit_scope 'PLACEMENT' declared on the row, admitted only when the consumed placement's role evidence is entirely VERIFIED. That mechanical bar turns out to be the whole story here: of the mapping's 18 placements, only 2 (both ONT, on air-permitting-and-dispersion-modeling and emissions-monitoring-and-compliance) carry all-VERIFIED evidence; the other 16, covering all 7 issuers this campaign has already profiled to COMPLETE (CATERPILLAR, CUMMINS, FUEL-TECH, CECO-ENVIRONMENTAL, TETRA-TECH, AECOM, JACOBS-SOLUTIONS), carry a single INFERRED-tagged role-evidence item apiece and are blocked by tools/check_screen.py's _placement_admissible regardless of profile status. ONT itself has no profile on disk. Net result: every one of this mapping's 18 placements is inadmissible this run, by one of the two independent gates (evidence tier, or profile completeness), and this screen seats zero rows across all 14 links. This is a structural finding about the mapping's evidence, not a search failure: nothing here was left unsearched.

emissions-aftertreatment-and-catalyst [MONEY CORNER, UNDISCOVERED, EXHAUSTED at 4/5]: searched and empty. The mapping's own link_coverage record closed this link EXHAUSTED with 4 public issuers established (Caterpillar, Cummins, Fuel Tech, CECO Environmental) via a 25-hit SEC EDGAR full-text search plus direct confirmation that the named private specialist (EcoCAT) is not public; a fifth known-public candidate, Johnson Matthey plc (LSE:JMAT, owner of Cormetech), could not be added for lack of a fetchable official UK securities source. All 4 counted issuers carry COMPLETE O2 profiles on disk (written this campaign) and would mechanically clear the profile-completeness half of admission. All 4 fail the other half: each placement's sole evidence item is tagged INFERRED (a Power Generation Enterprises compliance-guide citation for Caterpillar; comparable single-source citations for the other three), never VERIFIED. The chain's own money-corner link is therefore genuinely empty this run because of the evidence tier alone, not because of missing coverage or missing profiles. The 4 placement audits landed this run (commit f187057) do not change this: they PASS the placement's identity and role claim in fresh context but leave the placement's own evidence tag INFERRED, and per CLAUDE.md text they admit these issuers to run deepdive, not to this screen. Promoting these 4 placements to screen-admissible needs either the placement's evidence tag itself raised to VERIFIED, or the whole mapping brought to a COMPLETE census audit; that is the corrected highest-leverage next step for this chain's money corner (see data_gaps).

state-air-permitting-authority [CHOKE_POINT, UNDISCOVERED, EXHAUSTED at 0/5]: searched and empty by construction. The mapping's own link_coverage record closes this link EXHAUSTED with 0 issuers: state and local minor-source air permitting authority is a governmental function performed by environmental agencies (Virginia DEQ and its Air Pollution Control Board stand in as the representative state) under Clean Air Act State Implementation Plans, and no private company anywhere performs this role. Zero placements exist on this link in the mapping; there is nothing for a screen to seat or to block, and the chain's own bottleneck note independently confirms this is the true gate on the map precisely because it has no instrument.

federal-minor-nsr-rule [UNDISCOVERED, EXHAUSTED at 0/5]: searched and empty by construction, same reasoning as state-air-permitting-authority one position downstream: the rulemaking (Federal Register 2026-13667) is published and administered solely by the U.S. EPA, a federal agency with no listed equity. Zero placements.

air-permitting-and-dispersion-modeling [UNDISCOVERED, TARGET_MET at 5/5]: searched and empty. Five issuers are mapped (TETRA-TECH, AECOM, JACOBS-SOLUTIONS, ONT, ICF-INTERNATIONAL), all ACTIVE placements. TETRA-TECH, AECOM and JACOBS-SOLUTIONS each carry a COMPLETE O2 profile but a single INFERRED-tagged evidence item, blocked on evidence tier exactly as the money-corner link above. ONT carries all-VERIFIED evidence (SEC EDGAR company-submissions metadata, tag VERIFIED) but has no profile on disk anywhere in the repo; it is mechanically admissible on the mapping side and blocked only by profile completeness, so it is this chain's best near-term candidate for run profile --campaign. ICF-INTERNATIONAL is blocked on both counts (INFERRED evidence, no profile).
